newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Singapore bunkers prices down on thin demand.
newsitem.headline: Singapore bunkers prices down on thin demand.

text.p: Singapore bunker quotes were lower from Monday with thin demand placing downward pressure on prices, traders said on Tuesday.
Demand was very thin as some shipowners were seen at the sidelines waiting for prices to ease further, traders said.
A major said he sold a 1,200 tonnes parcel of bunker 180-cst at $123.50 per tonne. Bunker 180-cst was mostly quoted at around $123-$124 and 380-cst at $127-$128, around a dollar lower from Monday.
MDO and gas oil were also stable at $231-$245 and $255-$262 per tonne respectively.
